what: Compass on a translucent disc — on entering the screen, the disc spins in from -500° and settles over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94), and the needle appears at .2s. After that the needle is tied to scroll (scrub .8) and turns 0 → 380° from when the section enters from the bottom of the screen until it leaves at the top. On hover the disc grows 1.11× and blurs what is behind it by 2px (.35s)

options.turn: Needle angle turned by scroll (degrees), default 380
options.spin: Plate angle before entering (deg), default -500 — 0 means it does not spin and only the needle appears
options.scrub: Delay for the needle to catch up with scroll (sec), default .8
options.trigger: Reference ancestor (css) for the range where the needle turns — defaults to the compass itself (section for a whole Section)
options.[data-fx-part=needle]: Needle graphic (svg·img) — center is the rotation axis
